title: Euclidean vs Graph Metric: The Fixed-Source Problem
summary: We prove that two fixed sources in the Euclidean plane can be realized by a bounded-degree planar unit-edge graph on a 10-net, with graph distance from each source agreeing with Euclidean distance up to a universal additive constant. We ask whether the analogous statement holds for three non-collinear sources, and prove a logarithmic obstruction for large ordered source sets in the coordinate-planar setting.
